scripts.setup: npm install && npm install --prefix frontend && cd backend && uv sync
scripts.backend: cd backend && uv run fastapi dev app/main.py --port 8002
scripts.start: npm run build && cd backend && uv run fastapi run app/main.py --port ${PORT:-8002}
scripts.lint: npm run lint --prefix frontend && cd backend && uv run ruff check app && uv run ruff format --check app
scripts.format: cd backend && uv run ruff check --fix app && uv run ruff format app
